sentences.japanese: 休み中に置き勉してると没収されるんだよな。
sentences.english: If you leave your textbooks at school during the break, they'll get confiscated.

sentences.japanese: 私たちの年代の卒業生たちはノー勉で卒業試験を受ける人が結構いたようです。
sentences.english: In our time, there were many students who passed the graduation exam without studying.

sentences.japanese: 「テストどうだった？」「やばいよ。0点かも」「は、まじで？」「テストあるの忘れててノー勉で受けたもん」
sentences.english: "How'd the test go?" "Horrible. I might've not even got a single question right." "What, are you serious?" "Well, I forgot we had a test, so I went in totally unprepared."
